name: devon-perf-playwright
description: Deliberately NOT a pnpm workspace package (pnpm-workspace.yaml lists only apps/* and packages/*), same reasoning as e2e/package.json -- these are measurement scripts (agentic/HARDENING.md H2.9/H24.1/H26.1 baseline), not product code, and manage their own npm-installed node_modules so this directory never needs pnpm-workspace.yaml touched. Pinned to the exact @playwright/test version e2e/package.json uses so both share the already-downloaded browser cache under %LOCALAPPDATA%/ms-playwright.
